channel.title: Voice Learning: Norwegian by Ear
channel.description: Listen-and-repeat Norwegian lessons for English speakers. Each episode explains a pattern, drills phrases at normal and slow speed, gives you silent gaps to speak, and ends with a dialogue and role play. Voices are computer generated.
channel.itunes:author: MJB

item.title: NOW1: Introducing yourself, asking questions, family
item.description: Say your name, ask where someone is from, ask yes/no questions and talk about a third person. Listen, repeat and answer in the gaps.
